items.description:
As AI agents increasingly write, analyze, and rewrite low-level code, generic toolchains become a bottleneck. Security researchers need semantics they can trust — deterministic compilation on the way in, and faithful decompilation on the way out. In the age of AI, everyone needs their own compiler and their own decoder.
Compile with NeverC, analyze and decompile with NeverD — an AI-friendly LLVM toolchain you control, built for security research.

items.title: NeverC
items.description: The AI-friendly C23 compiler for security research. Pure C23, integrated linker, DynCode pipeline, cross-platform PE/ELF/Mach-O generation, compile-time string encryption, and a plugin API spanning 130+ compiler phases — designed so LLM-generated code compiles correctly more often than C++ alternatives.

repo_info.description: The AI-friendly C23 compiler for security research, built on LLVM [WIP]

items.title: NeverD
items.description: The AI-friendly binary analysis & decompilation engine with 1:1 instruction-level lifting. PE/ELF/Mach-O support, strict semantic fidelity, structured C and LLVM IR output, binary rewrite, and a pure C SDK () built for CLI tools, integrators, and AI agents.

repo_info.description: The AI-friendly binary analysis & decompilation engine — 1:1 lift, built on LLVM [WIP]

items.title: NeverC & NeverD — Your Compiler & Decoder for the AI Era
